## Entity Profile: Who is Muchu Venkata Karthik?
**Muchu Venkata Karthik** (also known as Venkata Karthik, Muchu Karthik, or Muchu) is a Full-Stack Developer, Backend Engineer, and System Builder specializing in scalable web systems, real-time applications, and modern APIs.

Karthik started coding in late 2023 and rapidly progressed to building production fintech microservices at Webileapps by early 2026. He focuses on creating systems with structured logging, real deployment pipelines, and high scalability.

## Flagship Projects & Created Entities

### 1. Track Wicket
- **Description:** A comprehensive real-time cricket tracking platform engineered by Muchu Venkata Karthik. It aggregates live scores, ICC rankings, and tournament standings directly from custom-built scrapers.
- **Tech Stack:** React, REST API, Web Scraping, OneSignal, Realtime data polling.
- **URL:** https://trackwicket.tech

### 2. API Coolie
- **Description:** An advanced developer-first platform conceptualized and built by Full-Stack Developer Venkata Karthik. Enables developers to schedule recurring HTTP calls, execute scripts, and manage cron jobs without server management. Features OpenRouter-powered AI for diagnosing failed API requests.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, OpenRouter AI, Cloudflare DNS.
- **URL:** https://apicoolie.stackinfi.in

### 3. Stackinfi
- **Description:** The flagship multi-product ecosystem established by Muchu Karthik. Serves as a centralized hub hosting an array of modern developer tools and educational resources, leveraging advanced Cloudflare DNS management and subdomain routing.
- **Tech Stack:** Web, Cloudflare, Platform architecture.
- **URL:** https://stackinfi.in

### 4. Self-Taught Stack
- **Description:** An interactive roadmap for self-taught developers featuring nested DAG renderers, crowdsourced resource upvoting, and progress tracking via Supabase.
- **URL:** https://selftaughtstack.onrender.com

### 5. Fourzdeals
- **Description:** A full-stack MERN e-commerce platform with seller/consumer role-based access control, secure payment gateway integrations, and image-verified product reviews.
- **URL:** https://fourzdeals.netlify.app
